content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Operates route-based gaming terminals in taverns and bars, not hotel lodging or hotel ownership."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Online marketplace connecting hosts and guests; it does not own or operate hotel properties."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Baseball franchise and ballpark; entertainment and sports, not overnight lodging."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Casino gaming is the core business; hotels only support the casino properties."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Casual seafood restaurants and package liquor stores, not hotel rooms or meeting space."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Live entertainment venues and ticketing; no hotel lodging business."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Casino resort gaming is the core business, with hotel rooms secondary to gambling."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings to corporate tenants, with no hotel or guest-room business."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Owns upscale hotels run by third-party managers, selling rooms, dining and meeting space to travelers and groups."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Casino resorts where gaming drives the business; hotel rooms are a supporting line."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Casual dining steakhouse restaurants and franchising; no lodging or hotel ownership."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Restaurant operator and brand licensor; food and beverage sales, not hotel lodging."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Theme parks selling admission and annual passes to families; not lodging or hotel operations."}]}
